description: Land Acquisition - Welikada, D/S Division, Sri Jayawardenapura Kotte, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, locations, and extents for acquisition for public purposes. The content focuses exclusively on land matters (acquisition of property) without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized categories.
